title: Denied boarding, four hours late, no taper
narrative: They would not let me on even though I had a confirmed seat and had checked in. I got there four hours late on the next one.

documents.content:
BOOKING AR9084 — Passenger: W. OSEI (adult)
Carrier: Aurelian (AR)
AR330  BRU 21 Jul 2026 07:05  ->  LIS 21 Jul 2026 09:15
Great-circle distance BRU-LIS: 1,720 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

AURELIAN INVOLUNTARY DENIED BOARDING NOTICE
Flight AR330, 21 Jul 2026. Passenger OSEI/W, PNR AR9084.
Passenger held a confirmed booking and completed check-in at 06:11Z. Boarding was refused at the gate because the flight was oversold by 4 seats.
Passenger was rebooked onto AR336, departing 11:40, arriving LIS 13:35.

LIS ARRIVALS 21JUL2026
Originally ticketed arrival (AR330): 09:15 local
Passenger OSEI/W travelled on AR336, actual on-blocks 13:35 local
Delay at final destination: 4h 20m

AURELIAN OPS LOG — AR330 / 21JUL2026
Status: OPERATED, OVERSOLD
Cause code: COM-OVERSOLD
Cause text: Revenue management oversold the cabin by 4 seats. 4 passengers involuntarily denied boarding.
AR330 itself departed and arrived on schedule.

derivation: S1.2(b) the passenger was denied boarding, which satisfies the limb directly
S2.1(c) involuntary denied boarding on a confirmed booking qualifies in its own right
S4.6 the notice ladder does not apply to denied boarding; it is compensated at 100% subject to S5.4
S5.4 the taper is confined to claims qualifying under S2.1(b) only; this claim qualifies under S2.1(c), so the 4h 20m arrival delay does not reduce the amount
